definitions.gloss: net profit; net income; bottom line
definitions.explanation: The profit remaining after all expenses, taxes, and costs have been deducted from total revenue. A fundamental term in business and accounting.

examples.japanese: {純利益|じゅんりえき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{今期|こんき}→今期：29530_konki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{純利益|じゅんりえき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{過去最高|かこさいこう}だった。
examples.english: This term's net profit was the highest ever.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{原材料費|げんざいりょうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{純利益|じゅんりえき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}した→減少する：19026_genshousuru⟧。
examples.english: Sales grew, but net profit decreased due to rising raw material costs.

notes: Composed of ⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧ (net, pure) + ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧ (profit). Abbreviated as {純益|じゅんえき}. Contrast with {粗利益|あらりえき} or {売上総利益|うりあげそうりえき} (gross profit — before deducting operating expenses) and ⟦{営業利益|えいぎょうりえき}→営業利益：22690_eigyourieki⟧ (operating profit — before deducting taxes and non-operating items). Common collocations: {純利益|じゅんりえき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (net profit increases), {純利益|じゅんりえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to post net profit).
